resources.string: Apply configs when Shizuku is ready

Off by default. Automatically applies saved configs after Shizuku starts, connects to this app, and permission is granted. Requests permission if needed. Rebooting alone does not apply configs: start Shizuku and grant permission first. Does not include persistent VoLTE.
Auto apply failed for %1$d SIM(s). Open the app to view logs.
Notifications are off. If the toast cannot be shown, the automatic apply result cannot be delivered as a notification.
* Real-time snapshot. IMS registration state changes when switching between LTE and 5G.
VoLTE, VoWiFi, VoNR, 5G and carrier overrides
Device-level network settings such as captive portal detection
Select a single SIM on the home screen to use SIM-specific advanced operations.
Read a real-time IMS capability snapshot for the selected SIM.
Restart IMS for the selected SIM. Use this only when registration is stuck.
Restore the selected SIM to its carrier defaults and restore the saved persistent VoLTE state.
View and export TensorIMS logs for troubleshooting.
Restart IMS for %1$s? Calls and network registration may be briefly interrupted. Carrier configuration will not be cleared.

Reset carrier configuration for %1$s? This clears all CarrierConfig overrides for this SIM after restoring any backed-up persistent VoLTE settings. On success, pending edits for this SIM will be discarded and configuration reloaded. On failure, the draft is retained; check the result before retrying.
Select a SIM on the home screen before editing IMS configuration.
No SIM information is available. Start and authorize Shizuku, then refresh.
Android uses captive portal detection URLs to determine whether the current network has working Internet access.
Remove TensorIMS overrides and let the system choose its configured endpoints.
Store custom HTTP and HTTPS detection URLs in SettingsProvider.
This field must use the %1$s scheme.

TensorIMS can verify the value stored in SettingsProvider, but some Android/NetworkStack builds may prefer a resource overlay over this setting. A successful write does not prove that the active probe URL has changed.
After changing this setting, reconnect the current network and verify actual behavior on your device.
Written to system settings. Reconnect the network and verify whether the new endpoints are used.
System overrides removed. Reconnect the network and verify the default behavior.
Customize the carrier name on lock screen and status bar; reset carrier configuration to restore
Customize the client User-Agent used for IMS registration; reset carrier configuration to restore
Enable 4G HD voice calling while using mobile data
Make and receive calls over Wi-Fi networks in weak signal areas
Allow Wi-Fi Calling while roaming (subject to carrier support and fees)
Choose how the carrier name appears during Wi-Fi Calling. The wording follows the system language and ROM.
Enable native carrier video calling in the dialer
Enable 5G SA native HD voice calls without falling back to 4G
Use secondary SIM data for primary SIM calling when primary SIM has no service
Configure call forwarding, call waiting, etc. over data without network fallback
Choose how USSD requests use CS or IMS. Requires support from the device and carrier.
CS uses the traditional cellular voice network; IMS uses IMS services. This setting does not change the preferred network type or force LTE only.
Try IMS when CS has no service
Allow fallback to CS when needed
Send requests through IMS without fallback to CS
Enable 5G mobile network support (Non-Standalone and Standalone)
Align 5G signal bar thresholds with LTE to improve weak-signal indicator display
Display 5G+ icon when connected to 5G Carrier Aggregation or 5G-A networks
Enable system-level enhanced 4G LTE carrier aggregation configuration
Show standard 4G/LTE icon without \'+\' even during carrier aggregation
Display \"4G\" icon instead of \"LTE\" on the status bar
Show 2G/3G/4G/5G even on Wi-Fi or with mobile data off. Behavior depends on the system and may use the default data SIM setting.
Shizuku is not running, please start Shizuku first
Please grant permission to read SIM card
Please update Shizuku to the latest version
Could not export logs. Please try again.
Takes effect immediately for this SIM. On compatible devices and carriers, VoLTE remains usable after a normal restart without starting Shizuku or opening TensorIMS.
You can still use Apply to enable 5G and other features. There is no need to uncheck VoLTE.
Select a single SIM to read or change these settings.
Start and authorize Shizuku to read, enable or restore these settings.
The required system interface is not supported on this device.
Could not complete the operation or verify all states. Refresh before retrying. Details: %s

Restore original settings returns VoLTE settings to their values before this feature was first enabled; it does not necessarily turn VoLTE off. Reset also restores saved settings for the selected active SIMs. Restore before uninstalling; uninstalling or clearing app data removes recovery records.

This feature only preserves VoLTE settings. Extra 5G, VoWiFi and VoNR configuration set through Apply still needs Shizuku and must be applied again after a restart. Actual calls depend on the device, carrier and network.
System updates or SIM changes may reset VoLTE settings. If calls stop working, start and authorize Shizuku, select the affected SIM, enable this feature again and test a call.
Enabled. Restart your phone and verify that VoLTE calls work.
Switches below represent the configuration to be written in this operation, not the current system status. Tap \"Apply changes\" at the bottom to apply.
Irreversible operations that remove TensorIMS CarrierConfig overrides
Switches show whether system configuration allows a feature. See IMS status for actual availability. Tap Apply changes after editing.
Could not read configuration. Please retry.
Start Shizuku and grant permission to read system configuration
No active SIM could be read. Refresh the SIM list and check Shizuku.
The active SIM list changed. Reload configuration before applying.
Applied and verified by reading back
Reloading will discard unapplied changes on this page.
Some or all changes could not be verified. Pending changes are retained; successful SIMs were saved. Retry or reload.
Some targets are unsupported, unreadable, or require a reset to restore and were skipped. Other changes are still pending.

These settings have no direct off switch, or their complete default parameters cannot be read. Use Reset carrier configuration below to clear all CarrierConfig overrides for the selected SIM and restore any backed-up persistent VoLTE settings.
Enter a nonempty custom value. To restore, use Reset carrier configuration at the bottom of this IMS configuration page. Empty text does not restore a value.
The current system value is not among these choices. It is preserved until you select another value.
Confirm your choice, then tap Apply changes. To restore carrier defaults, select one SIM and use Reset carrier configuration below; this clears all carrier configuration overrides for that SIM.
Turning off restores system-provided default parameters, not carrier defaults.
Choose the display language for this app. Changes apply immediately.
The previous operation has not been confirmed as finished. Check it first; restart the device and retry if needed.
The operation has not finished or needs recovery. Complete the check before switching.
The operation result or permission cleanup is not confirmed. It will not retry automatically; wait for the old task to finish, then refresh and check.
Current system state checked; the previous operation was not replayed. Auto-restore is still paused; check, then turn the switch off and on again.
The old operation or permission cleanup is not confirmed.
Could not verify the embedded service. Restart it.
Start the external Shizuku app first.
Allow TensorIMS to use the external Shizuku.
Could not connect to the external Shizuku. Check the service state.
The backend is not initialized yet.
The switch did not complete. Refresh the current backend and retry.
The switch did not complete; the original mode was kept. Refresh and retry.
The current operation has not finished. Switch later.
The old backend is not confirmed safely closed. Retry later.
The old backend is not confirmed safely closed; the mode was not switched.
Could not save the mode selection.
The backend state changed. Refresh and retry.
The current operation is not complete. Switch later.
The embedded service stop is not confirmed. Refresh and check.
The auto-start request is stale or the current operation does not allow starting.
The old operation needs recovery; a new service cannot be started.
The current operation is not complete. Start later.
The embedded service failed to start. Check the start method.
The request was cancelled or the mode already changed.
Select and connect a privileged backend first.
The operation record could not be saved reliably; execution was blocked.
The operation result is not confirmed. It will not retry automatically; refresh and check later.
The written final state lacks an operation result. Check the current system state first.
The broker written final state lacks an operation result. Check first.
The operation or cleanup result is not confirmed. Recover and check first.
The reset final state is incomplete. Recover and check first.
The reset recovery guard could not be saved reliably. Recover and check first.
The operation record is not complete. Refresh and check.
Auto-apply was paused safely. After checking the current configuration, turn the switch off and on again.
The restore could not be confirmed; the original-value backup and operation record were kept. Check later.
There is no persistent VoLTE operation to restore.
The old operation is not confirmed finished. Wait, or restart the device and check.
Restore the connection to the currently selected backend first.
The restore result is not confirmed; the original-value backup and operation record were kept. Refresh and check.
A check is in progress. Restore later.
Restart the device first, then connect the selected backend and refresh state.
Connect the selected backend and complete authorization first.
The check did not pass; the record and backup were kept. Restart the device and retry.
The check is still in progress; the record and backup were kept. Refresh state later.
The current operation is not complete. Check later.
Could not complete the check; the record and backup were kept. Refresh state.

Current state checked and the corrupt record was kept; the last operation result could not be confirmed. Check the IMS configuration, system network and VoLTE original-value backup; auto-apply is still paused.

Attempted to clear the carrier configuration overrides, but the system provided no independently verifiable evidence that deletion completed, so this was not recorded as a successful reset. Check the current configuration first; auto-restore remains paused.
